consequence.statement: Existing ImageRepository objects stay stored as v1beta2 until rewritten; a storage version migration and a status.storedVersions update are needed before a later release removes v1beta2.
consequence.remediation: Re-write all ImageRepository objects and update status.storedVersions of the CRD to drop v1beta2.

assertion.statement: The storage version of the ImageRepository CRD changes from v1beta2 to v1, so existing objects need a storage version migration and status.storedVersions must be updated before a later release removes v1beta2.
